title: intake_to_flow output
description: Output of the intake_to_flow flow. Validated strictly with unknown fields rejected, then reference-checked: every action type must exist in the supplied vocabulary, every selector must use a permitted strategy, and every URL must fall inside allowedOrigins. A flow requiring an out-of-scope origin is rejected, not clamped. Any value the flow cannot ground must appear in unknowns rather than being invented.

groundingNotes.description: One note per derived step, quoting the span of the report it came from. Forces the interpretation to be traceable to what was actually reported.

rejections.description: Anything the report asked for that the flow refused to encode, and why. For example an origin outside the allowlist or an action type outside the vocabulary.

confidenceNote.description: Free-text note on interpretation confidence. Recorded and displayed, never used as a gate.
